S046-thm:reflsubunv-forall.title: thm:reflsubunv-forall
S046-thm:reflsubunv-forall.difficulty_reason: Result: the dependent product of a P-valued family over any A lies in the reflective subuniverse P — the standard closure of a modality under Pi-types. What the proof must do itself: invent the family of evaluation maps ev_x, lift each along rec_modal, and reassemble the lifts into a single h by dependent abstraction; the actual content is the choice of retract and reading off the retraction. Allowed background (cited or ambient, not proved here): the universal property of reflect/rec_modal and the fact that a retraction of the unit puts a type in P; both are the defining machinery of reflective subuniverses established earlier in the same section, so no external theorem is doing the mathematics. Not H3: every ingredient is a textbook standard part, there is no new object, no self-invented mechanism and no lower-bound or existence argument whose decisive step is carried by this proof beyond a routine universal-property application; as flagged in the batch instructions, short tool lemmas judged H2 are the norm, and the earlier blind re-judgment lesson (H3 overshoot, 4/62) argues against promotion here. S046-thm:reflsubunv-forall.h3_criterion_note: Decisive step: building the retraction. The proof defines ev_x : (prd{x:A} B(x)) -> B(x) with 'ev_x(f) \defeq f(x)', lifts it because 'Since $B(x)$ lies in $P$, this extends to a function' rec_modal(ev_x) into a type that is already modal, then glues: 'we can define $h:\reflect(\prd{x:A} B(x)) \to \prd{x:A} B(x)$ by $h(z)(x) \defeq \rec{\modal}(\mathsf{ev}_x)(z)$', and closes with 'Then $h$ is a retraction of $\project_{\prd{x:A} B(x)}$, so that ${\prd{x:A} B(x)}$ is in $\P$.' Criterion (iii) is what settles the tier: the proof is a direct universal-property application resting on the standard modal toolkit — rec_modal plus the retraction criterion — with no self-created object and no new mechanism, exactly the 'mechanism uses only standard parts' case that the batch rules send to H2; criterion (ii) is also only partially met, since the statement is a structural closure lemma of the reflective-subuniverse toolkit rather than a research-level or foundationally decisive theorem.

S046-thm:zfc.difficulty_reason: 实质要求：断言“在带 $\choice{}$ 与宇宙 $\UU$ 的类型论中，累积层谱 $V$ 是带选择公理的 Zermelo--Fraenkel 集合论 ZFC 的模型”，即给出 $V\models$ ZFC 的证明。允许引用（本证明的依赖全部在此）：(a) 书中关于累积层谱的前置定理 $\cref{thm:VisCST}$——证明开门见山把“除幂集外的全部公理”整批外包：“We have all the axioms listed in \cref{thm:VisCST}, plus full separation”；(b) 排中律 $\LEM{}$（由假设的 $\choice{}$ 可得）；(c) 标准集合论观察——$\LEM$ 下幂集就是函数类型。必须由本证明完成的部分：仅“$V$ 有幂集”一项，且其论证是把幂集定义为 $(a\to\bool)$：原文 'so we just need to show that there are power sets $\power a:V$ for all $a:V$.
